newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 1c to 589c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 1c to 589c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market improved slightly at auctions in Sydney and Adelaide on Wednesday, taking the eastern market indicator up by one cent to 589 cents a kg clean, Wool International (WI) said.
In merinos, the 19/22/23/25 micron indicators were 0.5 percent dearer, WI said.
The 20m category was slightly cheaper while 21m was 1.0 percent cheaper.
The 24m class was unchanged while 26m was 1.0 percent dearer.
Merino skirtings were generally unchanged, it said.
